record.body:
## Problem

CI runs no Node tooling. A broken Svelte or TypeScript change merges unchecked. The repo has no lint or format standard for TypeScript and Svelte, and `AGENTS.md` has no section for them.

## Approach

Add one `web` CI job that always runs: `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, `npm run build` in `dashboard/web/ui` (decision `web-ci-job-shape`). `npm run lint` runs `biome check` with warnings counted as errors. Add Biome with full Svelte support at an exact version, configured by `biome.json` (decision `ts-lint-tool`). Fix the existing findings and keep the gate at zero findings (decision `lint-findings-policy`). Add a TypeScript and Svelte section to `AGENTS.md`. The UI stays at `dashboard/web/ui`. The job uses Node 22 through `actions/setup-node` with the npm cache.

## Exit criteria

Requirement ids come from the phase specification.

- R1, R2: The `web` job runs `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` in order, with no path filter (tests that parse `.github/workflows/ci.yml`).
- R3, R4: A deliberate type error fails `npm run check`, and a deliberate lint finding fails `npm run lint` (local tests on a temporary copy). Two pushed branches fail the `web` job the same way (CI observations).
- R5, R6: Biome is an exact-version devDependency, and `biome.json` enables full Svelte support (tests).
- R7, R10: `npm run lint` and `npm run check` exit 0 on the tree (commands).
- R8, R9: `AGENTS.md` has a TypeScript and Svelte section that names the three commands (tests).
- Integration: the `ci.yml` `web` run lines pass in order from the real entry point (test).

## Proof

kind: commands. A human looks at the green `web` job in a CI run and at the two failing runs for the deliberate type error and lint finding.

## Landing

Branch `phase/node-ci`. Worktree `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/node-ci`. Base `main`. Close by committing code on the phase branch, merging that branch into `main`, then committing the store on the primary checkout. Push is a human stop.

## Shape

Size: one sitting.
Human stops: the R3 and R4 CI observations need a push of three branches. The agent leaves them unsigned until a human pushes.
Collision: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` also changes in the open `wheel-smoke` phase (a `wheel` job). Add the `web` job after the `types` job and touch no other job. `dashboard/web/ui/package.json` and `package-lock.json` change only in this phase.
